title: Auditor-Toolkit — certified engines with executable falsifiers
description:
Four self-contained interactive demos and the instruments that certify them. Each page publishes its own limit: what it does not prove. The JavaScript engine is verified against a frozen Python oracle through fixtures that are regenerated from a tagged commit, and the boundary controls are pinned by a mutation battery that must turn red when the instrument degrades. A verifier that passes on a real defect is itself a defect.

Demos: Electromagnetic field classifier, Cl(1,3) — frame-invariant classification of a bivector field; Does your null have teeth? — resampling nulls that actually bite; El piso de detección — ε is not a tolerance; El umbral — does the attempt pay, and do you survive collecting it? (threshold p_min with Monte Carlo).

Español: cuatro demos interactivas autocontenidas y los instrumentos que las certifican. Cada página publica su límite —lo que no prueba—. La paridad entre el oráculo en Python y el motor en JavaScript se verifica con fixtures congelados y regenerables, y los controles de borde se pinzan con una batería de mutaciones que debe fallar en rojo al degradar el instrumento.

Live: https://alexisromtz-lab.github.io/auditor-toolkit/
